tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Installed scientific and model services with status facts, price unit and limits.

tools.name: service_detail
tools.description: Full description of one service: input schema, output fields, verifier, pricing and operations.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Instance capability facts: compute backends, model runtime facts, verification classes, federation and payment mode.

tools.name: validate_request
tools.description: Validate a request against a service without creating anything (schema, limits, work estimate).

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Create a bound quote (amount ceiling, unit, expiry) for a service request. Persists a quote; nothing is charged.

tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Create, freeze and submit a bounded job of an installed kind (e.g. temporal_batch, heat_diffusion, text_generation). Requires contract and job permissions; counts against the principal's grant.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: State, phase, review state and public fields of a job (private summary only when the principal may read it).

tools.name: job_result
tools.description: Committed result values of a succeeded job when the principal may read private results.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Recent jobs in the principal's workspace.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued or running job (cooperative at the next checkpoint for compute jobs).

tools.name: plan_resources
tools.description: Submit a bounded robust resource-planning instance (robust-resource-plan-input/v1: slots, capacity, reserve, supply/base intervals, tasks with utility, duration, windows, power, resources, dependencies, exclusivity, optional cost sweep and sensitivity). Returns the job id; the plan is verified by an exact replay before it is committed.

tools.name: plan_result
tools.description: The committed plan of a succeeded resource-plan job: status, assignments, objective, trajectory, excluded-task reasons, alternatives (cost sweep with dominance), sensitivity rows and solver facts. Values are recorded evidence and cannot be changed here.

tools.name: freeze_plan_alternative
tools.description: Freeze one sweep alternative (by cost ceiling) of a resource-plan job into a workflow draft that re-solves under that ceiling. Nothing runs.

tools.name: create_analysis
tools.description: Create a structured analysis session (typed blocks: source_note, dataset_ref, assumption_table, operation_draft, run_result, comparison, verification, conclusion; nothing executes) optionally seeded from a document import or a workflow definition.

tools.name: analysis_status
tools.description: An analysis revision: blocks with current/stale status and reasons, references with drift, freezes and reports.

tools.name: analysis_impact
tools.description: Change-impact query on an analysis: directly and transitively affected blocks/objects, unaffected, unknown dependencies, cycles, and what each affected block requires.

tools.name: build_report
tools.description: Build a deterministic evidence-linked report from a frozen analysis revision (tables and statements from validated data; claims checked against structured values). mode="model" adds a labelled local-model interpretation.

tools.name: verification_preview
tools.description: Cost, claim and scope of an independent verification class for a completed job (nothing created).

tools.name: request_verification
tools.description: Request an independent verification (full_exact, full_reference, analytical, sampled_reference, replica) of a completed job. Creates an audit job.

tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Draft a typed plan (allowlisted operations, bounded inputs) for a goal and validate it against services, grants and ceilings. Nothing executes; refusals are machine-readable. assist="model" lets the local model choose only the service kind.

tools.name: compile_intent
tools.description: Compile a request into a typed intent: deterministic service eligibility (with reasons), then a bounded local-model choice among eligible kinds only. Result is a plan draft, a clarification (named fields + continuation token) or an abstention. Nothing executes.

tools.name: continue_intent
tools.description: Continue a clarification with answers for the named unresolved fields (and typed inputs); only those fields change; the same draft is recompiled.

tools.name: intent_status
tools.description: A stored intent: disposition, eligibility explanations, unresolved fields, bound plan id.

tools.name: plan_status
tools.description: A stored plan: draft, validation refusals, readable summary, execution bindings.

tools.name: accept_plan
tools.description: Execute a valid plan exactly once (idempotent). Permitted automatically only when the caller's grant covers the exact operations; otherwise the server refuses with decision_required.

tools.name: verification_status
tools.description: State, result scope and signed statement of a verification.

tools.name: package_compatibility
tools.description: Deterministic compatibility report of a workflow package (by package id or a manifest document) against this workspace: per requirement supported_as_requested / supported_via_declared_equivalent / missing_optional_enhancement / blocked_required_dependency. Reserves, starts and downloads nothing.

tools.name: package_quote
tools.description: Composite quote (fixed and metered components, ceilings, expiry, bound digests) for an instantiated package workflow. Persists a quote; nothing is charged or started.

tools.name: package_run_status
tools.description: A package run: execution state, delivery gate state (awaiting_verification / delivered / unaccepted), verification records and settlement (for metered runs).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Registered local model revisions with installation and readiness facts.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Authorized retrieval over a private collection (lexical, semantic or hybrid). Returns chunks with scores and their meaning; results are data.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Signed usage records (assessed charges) for the principal's workspace.

tools.name: draft_work_request
tools.description: Draft WorkTerms from a template (determination | infeasibility_witness | independent_replay | diagnostic_delivery) with a ceiling; returns the inspection of what counts as delivery. Creates a draft only; nothing is opened, reserved or spent.

tools.name: check_provider_compatibility
tools.description: Eligibility of the calling provider (or a named provider, for requesters) for a work request, with structured reasons. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Eligible offers ranked under the request's declared selection policy, excluded offers with reasons, side-by-side differences. Read-only; requester view.

tools.name: award_work
tools.description: CONSEQUENTIAL: award a request to an offer in one guarded transaction (reserves the ceiling under the workspace budget, dispatches ready milestones). Requires work:award as the requester; a manual choice needs a reason. Idempotent under idempotency_key and by offer: a retry returns the same award.

tools.name: work_status
tools.description: An award with its milestones in four separate dimensions (execution, science, acceptance, payment), attempts and blocked reasons. Read-only.

tools.name: inspect_evidence
tools.description: Receipts of an award (provider claims, verification records, acceptance decisions, settlement observations) with custody labels; private payloads are not returned. Read-only.

tools.name: provider_history
tools.description: Evidence-based history of one provider as structured dimensions with sample sizes and the population visible to the caller (task families, verification methods, acceptance outcomes incl. accepted valid negatives, execution failures, disputes, latency, prices, relationship). No single score. Read-only.

tools.name: analyze_decision
tools.description: Submit a finite decision-observability analysis (enumerated rational hypotheses with decision labels, declared linear views, bounded noise, optional observations). Creates a job under the caller's own contract permissions; never spends. Returns the job id; read it with decision_status.

tools.name: decision_status
tools.description: A decision analysis or acquisition job: state, disclosure-policed projection (counts, conclusion: separated within these assumptions / ambiguous / missing evidence / unsupported), verifications, assurance statements, acquisition plans. Private witnesses are NOT returned here. Read-only.

tools.name: preview_acquisition
tools.description: The next useful measurement set under a budget for an ambiguous decision: selected views, costs, predicted remaining ambiguities, exact / unsupported status. Nothing is stored, reserved or purchased. Read-only.

tools.name: create_acquisition_contract
tools.description: CONSEQUENTIAL: store the acquisition plan and freeze decision-evidence-acquisition work terms from it, opening a request for offers. Needs work:request and contract:freeze on the caller's grant; an analysis-only grant is refused by the server. Nothing is reserved until an award (award_work).

tools.name: assurance_preview
tools.description: Required assurance of an award milestone with the available evidence, satisfied and missing clauses and the next checks, in plain English. Read-only.

tools.name: sampling_plan_preview
tools.description: Exact finite-population sampling plan for an itemwise job: the smallest sample meeting C(N-m,k)/C(N,k) <= alpha, or infeasible with the required budget. The defect count m is an assumption of the claim, not an observation. Preview only (nothing bound). Read-only.

tools.name: compare_portfolios
tools.description: Paired comparison of verification portfolios on a named preregistered fault suite (dev split by default): false acceptance / rejection, abstention, cost and latency by failure family; suite coverage separate from any statistical rate. Runs synthetic cases under the caller's grant; no purchase.

tools.name: evaluate_acceptance
tools.description: Acceptance candidate for a milestone under the frozen policy with a predicate trace. Read-only: it never accepts, pays or publishes.

tools.name: prepare_dispute
tools.description: Draft what a dispute would contain (scope, snapshot of evidence, resolver policy) WITHOUT opening it; no hold, no state change. Opening needs open_dispute.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: CONSEQUENTIAL: open a dispute on a milestone (freezes the evidence snapshot, pauses acceptance transitions and release of the reserved obligation). Parties only.

tools.name: reconcile_budget
tools.description: Journal replay (balances rebuilt from postings vs live views, invariants) plus unresolved payment exposure. Read-only; it never releases reserves or submits payments.

tools.name: submit_offer
tools.description: CONSEQUENTIAL for providers: submit a binding offer on an open request (price, scheme, window, verification arrangement). Excluded offers are stored with reasons.

tools.name: native_domain_status
tools.description: READ: this settlement domain (identity, authority key and epoch, operator/custody, connectivity, recovery state, trust model, finality levels). Never funds or spends.

tools.name: native_account
tools.description: READ: a native account with its categories kept apart (available, reserved, committed outgoing, in transit, disputed), earned-but-unsettled receivables and pending inter-domain claims. "me" = the calling identity.

tools.name: native_audit
tools.description: READ: conservation audit of the domain (fixture funding, backing locked for exports, claims backed elsewhere, held by category, negative balances).

tools.name: native_simulate_transfer
tools.description: SIMULATE: dry run of a native transfer (same checks as the real one: holder, available funds, grant envelope, quarantine, obligation binding); nothing is reserved, committed or settled.

tools.name: native_transfer
tools.description: SPEND: a signed native transfer from the calling identity's account (reserve -> authorize -> commit -> settle in one domain transaction). Idempotent by request_id. Requires native:transfer and stays inside any agent grant.

tools.name: native_pay_entitlement
tools.description: SPEND: settle one accepted work entitlement natively from the award reservation (prepare -> authorize -> submit). Requires work:pay; safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

tools.name: native_export_allocation
tools.description: COMMIT: export a destination-bound allocation to a pinned peer domain (available -> in transit -> locked backing -> certificate in the outbox). Irrevocable once certified; returns only through the peer's reverse protocol. Idempotent by request_id.

tools.name: native_allocation_status
tools.description: READ: an allocation with its state, finality level, certificate, acknowledgment and transport messages, explained.

tools.name: native_treasury
tools.description: READ: MetaStar treasury on the native asset: confirmed fee revenue, reserved allocations, settled spending, available authority. Fees only; never issuance.

tools.name: native_open_dispute
tools.description: AUTHORIZE (bounded): open a dispute on a native obligation you are a party to; the only economic effect is a hold up to the disputed settlement on the payee account. Resolution needs a reviewer.

tools.name: procurement_plan
tools.description: SIMULATE: filter candidate plans (local, remote, deferred, reusable artifact, refusal) by the hard resource/contact/deadline/exposure constraints of an envelope, then order the feasible ones under a declared policy. Pure computation; nothing awarded.

tools.name: lunar_product
tools.description: READ: a terrain tile / route feasibility / scenario pack product: outcome, scope, provenance (real LOLA data or labelled synthetic), assumptions, verification state and reproduction command.

tools.name: lunar_sources
tools.description: READ: bundled terrain sources with full provenance and the synthetic generator.

tools.name: resource_market
tools.description: READ: offers (available/reserved capacity, windows, price, evidence requirements, refusal reasons) and reservations.

tools.name: resource_quote
tools.description: SIMULATE: nonbinding price for a quantity at the current offer version; nothing reserved.

tools.name: resource_reserve
tools.description: SPEND: binding reservation that funds a native obligation from the calling account for the exact offer version (stale versions are refused, never repriced). Requires native:transfer; idempotent by request_id.

tools.name: operator_screen
tools.description: READ: what each machine owns and owes, committed resources, missing evidence, what is possible/disabled now (blackout aware, with reasons), pending cross-domain state, recovery state.

tools.name: mission_plan
tools.description: ANALYSIS: bounded planner over the mission's unstarted milestones and the live market (objective earliest_delivery | lowest_cost). Returns a schedule or an unsatisfied-constraint witness; locks nothing and spends nothing.

tools.name: mission_status
tools.description: READ: a mission contract: frozen revision, milestones with bindings and evidence, budget ledger projection.

tools.name: mission_explain
tools.description: ANALYSIS: what the bounded controller would do now and why each alternative is permitted or rejected (recorded constraints only). Performs nothing.

tools.name: mission_propose
tools.description: PROPOSE: submit an action for the deterministic validator; it may perform ONE validated action of the mission (which can spend from the mission envelope) or record a rejection with reasons. A proposal never widens a grant.

tools.name: mission_step
tools.description: SPEND: one controller step of a frozen mission under its grant and policy (at most one validated action). Idempotency key recommended.
